name: Booth's Finest Old Dry Gin
production: Botanicals soaked overnight in pure spirit
Long, slow distillation in a historic-style copper pot still
Rested about 30 days in PX sherry casks
history: 2019 | Sazerac began restoring the original 1700s recipe and moved production back to the UK
serve_official: Neat or with sparkling spring water; classic tonic with lemon or orange garnish (Gin Guild)
notes: Recipe described as dating to the 1700s (backlog 1740 not confirmed by fetched pages) [cần kiểm tra]. Sazerac brand page had no product details.
